'''Wesau T'orrin''' was an individual hailing from the<ref name="JQ" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Rezi system/Legends|Rezi system]]</ref> [[Astronomer/Legends|astronomical]] object [[Rezi-9]].<ref name="JQ" /> In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]'' to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> T'orrin participated in the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] skill event of the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] on the<ref name="JQ" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC Euceron">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Euceron system/Legends|Euceron system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Euceron]].<ref name="JQ" />
